titulo.es: EE. UU., Dinamarca y Groenlandia firman acuerdo de seguridad
titulo.en: Trump’s threat to annihilate Iran to UN general assembly is stunning, even for him

sintesis.es: UU., Dinamarca y Groenlandia firmaron un acuerdo de seguridad que otorga a Washington presencia militar permanente en la isla ártica. El pacto prohíbe que actores ajenos a la OTAN tengan presencia en el territorio, además se respeta la autodeterminación local y soberanía nacional.
sintesis.en: US president may have upstaged the ghost of Soviet leader Khrushchev by musing destruction of fellow member state Donald Trump has a habit of discomfiting delegates to the United Nations general assembly. But this year, he may have upstaged the ghost of Nikita Khrushchev by openly contemplating the annihilation of a fellow UN member state. Eleven minutes into a 40-minute address, the US president announced he had “a big decision to make” over Iran, which has staged a much more determined resistance than Trump anticipated when he decided to go to war against the country in February.

titulo.es: "Aliados latinoamericanos de Trump planean calificar carteles como 'terroristas'": 'The New York Times'
titulo.en: California and New York sue over Trump push to halt wind energy projects

sintesis.es: En Revista de Prensa analizamos el titular del diario 'The New York Times' sobre cómo la Administración de Donald Trump y aliados latinoamericanos estarían preparando la designación de organizaciones criminales como "terroristas". El medio estadounidense asegura que el anuncio se daría en el marco de la Asamblea General de Naciones Unidas y advierte que podría contribuir a vulnerar la soberanía de los países de la región e incluso afectar a la población civil, además de ser un insumo de persecución contra opositores.
sintesis.en: US officials have begun to buy back wind leases as president seek to block renewables in favor of fossil fuels Democratic attorneys general from California and New York have sued the Trump administration over its plans to buy back offshore wind leases as Donald Trump seeks to discourage the expansion of wind energy in favor of fossil fuels. California attorney general Rob Bonta said he was suing over removal of a project off his state’s coast planned by Chicago-based Invenergy. The Trump administration said in June it was buying back the company’s US offshore wind leases for four wind projects on the east and west coasts.

titulo.es: Sri Lanka Easter bombings: 15 sentenced to hundreds of years in prison each over deadly terror attacks
titulo.en: Sri Lanka Easter bombings: 15 sentenced to hundreds of years in prison each over deadly terror attacks

sintesis.es: Islamic State-inspired bombings of churches and hotels in 2019 was one of the country’s worst ever attacks A court in Sri Lanka has convicted 15 men on terrorist charges for their involvement in the deadly 2019 Easter bombings and sentenced them each to at least 220 years in prison. The terror attacks, which targeted luxury hotels and churches as they held Easter services, left 267 people dead and wounded almost 6000. The bombings, which were inspired by Islamic State (IS), were among the deadliest terror attacks in Sri Lanka’s history and sent shockwaves through the country.

titulo.es: El huracán Polo alcanza categoría 5 y amenaza la costa del Pacífico mexicano
titulo.en: Hurricane Polo reaches Category 5 and threatens Mexico's Pacific coast

sintesis.es: El huracán Polo se intensificó rápidamente hasta alcanzar la categoría 5 en la escala Saffir-Simpson, con vientos sostenidos de hasta 265 km/h, convirtiéndose en una de las tormentas más fuertes jamás registradas en el Pacífico. Es el tercer huracán categoría 5 de la temporada, tras Genevieve y Lowell, y su intensificación se atribuye a patrones de El Niño más fuertes de lo habitual. Aunque avanza en paralelo a la costa suroeste de México sin previsión de impacto directo, las autoridades mantienen vigilancia en cinco estados por posibles lluvias.
sintesis.en: Hurricane Polo rapidly intensified to Category 5 on the Saffir-Simpson scale, with sustained winds of up to 265 km/h, becoming one of the strongest storms ever recorded in the Pacific. It is the third Category 5 hurricane of the season, following Genevieve and Lowell, with its rapid intensification attributed to stronger-than-usual El Niño patterns. While moving parallel to Mexico's southwestern coast without a forecast direct landfall, authorities maintain vigilance across five states due to potential rainfall.
